class Checks {

  static String run(int n) {
    assert(n >= 0);
    try {
      assert(n < 10, 'too big: $n');
    } catch (e) {
      return 'caught: $e';
    }
    try {
      assert(n != 5);
    } catch (e) {
      return 'bare: $e';
    }
    return 'ok: $n';
  }

}
